meanings.tr: gözünde fazla büyütmek, hak ettiğinden fazla değer vermek
meanings.en: to value or rate something too highly
meanings.exampleEn: Critics often overrate films that are simply expensive to make.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler genellikle sadece yapımı pahalı olan filmleri gözünde fazla büyütür.

meanings.en: partly covering or coinciding with something else
meanings.exampleEn: The two committees have overlapping responsibilities.
meanings.exampleTr: İki komitenin birbiriyle örtüşen sorumlulukları var.

meanings.en: to a degree that is too much
meanings.exampleEn: He drinks excessively and it is harming his health.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşırı derecede içiyor ve bu sağlığına zarar veriyor.

meanings.en: bigger than the usual or standard size
meanings.exampleEn: She wore an oversized coat that almost reached the floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Neredeyse yere kadar uzanan, normalden büyük bir palto giymişti.

meanings.en: smaller than the usual or required size
meanings.exampleEn: The undersize fish must be thrown back into the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Normalden küçük balıklar tekrar denize bırakılmalı.

meanings.en: to remove someone powerful from office, especially by force
meanings.exampleEn: The general was deposed in a military coup.
meanings.exampleTr: General bir askeri darbeyle görevden uzaklaştırıldı.

meanings.en: to support or maintain a decision, law or principle
meanings.exampleEn: The court upheld the original verdict.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme ilk kararı onayladı.

meanings.en: soft material used to protect or fill something
meanings.exampleEn: The jacket has extra padding around the shoulders.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceketin omuzlarında fazladan dolgu var.

meanings.en: clothes worn in bed
meanings.exampleEn: The children were already in their nightclothes when I arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Ben geldiğimde çocuklar çoktan gece kıyafetlerini giymişti.

meanings.en: written documents that provide information or proof
meanings.exampleEn: Please submit all the necessary documentation with your application.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen başvurunuzla birlikte gerekli tüm belgeleri gönderin.

meanings.en: a line of people moving forward in a ceremonial way
meanings.exampleEn: A funeral procession moved slowly through the streets.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir cenaze alayı sokaklardan yavaşça geçti.

meanings.en: to walk with regular steps, especially in a group
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers marched through the town square.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler kasaba meydanından geçit yaptı.

meanings.en: the act of not doing or having something, especially not voting
meanings.exampleEn: The resolution passed with three abstentions.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar üç çekimser oyla kabul edildi.

meanings.en: a very small spot or particle
meanings.exampleEn: There was a speck of dust on the lens.
meanings.exampleTr: Lensin üzerinde bir toz zerresi vardı.

meanings.en: very enthusiastic or passionate
meanings.exampleEn: She is an ardent supporter of human rights.
meanings.exampleTr: O, insan haklarının ateşli bir savunucusu.

meanings.en: showing strong and sincere feelings
meanings.exampleEn: He made a fervent appeal for peace.
meanings.exampleTr: Barış için ateşli bir çağrıda bulundu.

meanings.en: in a passionate and enthusiastic way
meanings.exampleEn: They ardently believed in the cause.
meanings.exampleTr: Davaya coşkuyla inanıyorlardı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows intense and sincere feeling
meanings.exampleEn: She fervently hoped that he would return.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun geri döneceğini içtenlikle umuyordu.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no interest or concern
meanings.exampleEn: He shrugged indifferently and walked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıtsızca omuz silkti ve uzaklaştı.

meanings.en: typical of the countryside; simple and plain
meanings.exampleEn: They stayed in a rustic cabin in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlarda sade, kırsal bir kulübede kaldılar.

meanings.en: in a way that accepts behaviour or opinions one dislikes
meanings.exampleEn: She smiled tolerantly at the children's noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukların gürültüsüne hoşgörüyle gülümsedi.

meanings.en: having strong feelings of loyalty or pride for one's nation
meanings.exampleEn: The speech had a strongly nationalistic tone.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmanın güçlü bir milliyetçi tonu vardı.

meanings.en: not showing love or support for one's country
meanings.exampleEn: Some called the protest unpatriotic.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazıları protestoyu vatanseverlikten uzak olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.en: strong loyalty and devotion to one's own nation
meanings.exampleEn: Rising nationalism shaped the country's politics.
meanings.exampleTr: Yükselen milliyetçilik ülkenin siyasetini şekillendirdi.

meanings.en: a person who gives money or help to a cause
meanings.exampleEn: The library was funded by a wealthy benefactor.
meanings.exampleTr: Kütüphane zengin bir hayırsever tarafından finanse edildi.

meanings.en: a person whose business is lending money at interest
meanings.exampleEn: He borrowed from a moneylender at a very high rate.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok yüksek faizle bir tefeciden borç aldı.

meanings.en: a shop where a pawnbroker lends money against pledged goods
meanings.exampleEn: She sold her ring at the pawnbroker's to pay the rent.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirayı ödemek için yüzüğünü rehinci dükkânında sattı.

meanings.en: a bar used to lift or move something, or a handle to operate a machine
meanings.exampleEn: Pull the lever to start the machine.
meanings.exampleTr: Makineyi çalıştırmak için kolu çekin.

meanings.en: too concerned with small details; hard to please
meanings.exampleEn: My son is a very fussy eater.
meanings.exampleTr: Oğlum yemek konusunda çok müşkülpesent.

meanings.tr: kılı kırk yarma, gereksiz ayrıntılarla uğraşma
meanings.en: finding fault with unimportant details
meanings.exampleEn: His constant nitpicking annoyed the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli kılı kırk yarması bütün ekibi rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: to pass urine from the body
meanings.exampleEn: The patient was asked to urinate into a sample cup.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastadan bir numune kabına idrar yapması istendi.

meanings.en: the tough outer skin of fruit, cheese or bacon
meanings.exampleEn: Grate the lemon rind into the cake mixture.
meanings.exampleTr: Limon kabuğunu kek karışımının içine rendeleyin.

meanings.en: to look quickly and secretly at something
meanings.exampleEn: She peeked through the curtains to see who was outside.
meanings.exampleTr: Dışarıda kimin olduğunu görmek için perdelerin arasından gizlice baktı.

meanings.en: to make a hole through something with a sharp object
meanings.exampleEn: The nail pierced the tyre.
meanings.exampleTr: Çivi lastiği deldi.

meanings.en: a medicine that destroys or stops the growth of bacteria
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the infection.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor enfeksiyon için bir antibiyotik reçete etti.

meanings.en: money paid regularly to someone after they retire
meanings.exampleEn: His retirement pay is barely enough to cover the bills.
meanings.exampleTr: Emekli maaşı faturaları karşılamaya zor yetiyor.

meanings.en: the quality of lasting a long time without breaking
meanings.exampleEn: These boots are known for their durability.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu botlar dayanıklılığıyla bilinir.

meanings.en: the state of not lasting forever
meanings.exampleEn: The poem reflects on the impermanence of life.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, hayatın geçiciliği üzerine düşünür.

meanings.en: holding firmly to something; very determined
meanings.exampleEn: She was tenacious in pursuing her goals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hedeflerinin peşinden gitmekte çok azimliydi.

meanings.tr: somut örnek, vücut bulmuş hali, timsali
meanings.en: a person or thing that represents a quality or idea perfectly
meanings.exampleEn: She is the embodiment of kindness.
meanings.exampleTr: O, iyiliğin vücut bulmuş halidir.

meanings.en: to be a clear example or expression of an idea or quality
meanings.exampleEn: The constitution embodies the values of the nation.
meanings.exampleTr: Anayasa, ulusun değerlerini somutlaştırır.

meanings.tr: tatlılıkla kandırma, dil dökme, ikna etme
meanings.en: the act of gently persuading someone to do something
meanings.exampleEn: After much coaxing, the child finally ate her vegetables.
meanings.exampleTr: Epey dil döktükten sonra çocuk sonunda sebzelerini yedi.

meanings.en: the act of persuading someone not to do something
meanings.exampleEn: All their dissuasion could not change his mind.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün vazgeçirme çabaları fikrini değiştiremedi.

meanings.tr: karamsar kişi, insanların iyi niyetine inanmayan kimse
meanings.en: a person who believes people act only out of self-interest
meanings.exampleEn: As a cynic, he doubted that politicians ever told the truth.
meanings.exampleTr: Karamsar biri olarak, politikacıların gerçeği söylediğine hiç inanmazdı.

meanings.en: filled with horror or shock
meanings.exampleEn: She was horrified by the news of the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza haberi karşısında dehşete düşmüştü.

meanings.en: a person who prepares and sells medicines; a pharmacist
meanings.exampleEn: The druggist filled her prescription quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Eczacı reçetesini hızlıca hazırladı.

meanings.en: a doctor or medical worker, especially in the military
meanings.exampleEn: A medic rushed to treat the injured soldier.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir sağlık görevlisi yaralı askere müdahale etmek için koştu.

meanings.en: a small cucumber used for pickling
meanings.exampleEn: He added a few gherkins to his sandwich.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandviçine birkaç kornişon ekledi.

meanings.en: careful and hard to please when choosing
meanings.exampleEn: She is very choosy about her friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşları konusunda çok seçicidir.

meanings.en: a removable cloth cover for a pillow
meanings.exampleEn: She changed the pillow cover before the guests arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Misafirler gelmeden önce yastık kılıfını değiştirdi.

meanings.tr: kaçakçılık, yasadışı alkol/ürün üretimi ve satışı
meanings.en: the illegal making or selling of goods, especially alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: Bootlegging was widespread during Prohibition.
meanings.exampleTr: İçki yasağı döneminde kaçakçılık çok yaygındı.

meanings.en: a pirate, especially of the 17th-century Caribbean
meanings.exampleEn: The novel tells the story of a daring buccaneer.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, gözüpek bir korsanın hikâyesini anlatır.

meanings.en: a deadly epidemic disease
meanings.exampleEn: The medieval city was ravaged by pestilence.
meanings.exampleTr: Ortaçağ kenti salgın hastalık tarafından kırıp geçirildi.

meanings.en: a person who writes plays
meanings.exampleEn: Shakespeare is the most famous English dramatist.
meanings.exampleTr: Shakespeare en ünlü İngiliz oyun yazarıdır.

meanings.en: the plot of a story, novel, film or play
meanings.exampleEn: The film has a complicated storyline.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin karmaşık bir olay örgüsü var.

meanings.en: a particular way of thinking about a matter
meanings.exampleEn: From a financial standpoint, the plan makes sense.
meanings.exampleTr: Mali açıdan bakıldığında, plan mantıklı.

meanings.en: an infectious viral disease that can cause paralysis
meanings.exampleEn: Vaccination has nearly eliminated poliomyelitis.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşılama çocuk felcini neredeyse tamamen ortadan kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a shine on a surface; or a brief explanation of a word
meanings.exampleEn: The magazine cover had a high gloss.
meanings.exampleTr: Derginin kapağı çok parlaktı.

meanings.en: the state of being disliked by many people
meanings.exampleEn: The tax led to the government's unpopularity.
meanings.exampleTr: Vergi, hükümetin halk nezdinde sevilmemesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: a roofed open platform along the side of a house
meanings.exampleEn: We sat on the veranda watching the sunset.
meanings.exampleTr: Verandada oturup gün batımını izledik.

meanings.en: designed for or appealing to wealthier customers
meanings.exampleEn: They opened an upmarket restaurant downtown.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde lüks bir restoran açtılar.

meanings.en: unable to stop thinking about something
meanings.exampleEn: He is obsessed with collecting old coins.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski para toplamaya takıntılı.

meanings.en: to delay something until a later time
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to defer the decision until next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararı gelecek aya ertelemeye karar verdiler.

meanings.en: likely to happen or become in the future
meanings.exampleEn: The agent showed the house to several prospective buyers.
meanings.exampleTr: Emlakçı evi birkaç müstakbel alıcıya gösterdi.

meanings.en: to walk in a proud, self-important way
meanings.exampleEn: He strutted across the stage to receive his award.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülünü almak için sahnede çalımla yürüdü.

meanings.en: to come before something in time or order
meanings.exampleEn: The classical period anteceded the romantic era.
meanings.exampleTr: Klasik dönem, romantik çağdan önce gelmiştir.

meanings.en: a difficult or unfortunate situation
meanings.exampleEn: The documentary highlighted the plight of refugees.
meanings.exampleTr: Belgesel mültecilerin içinde bulunduğu kötü durumu gözler önüne serdi.

meanings.en: describing an adjective placed before the noun it modifies
meanings.exampleEn: In 'a red car', 'red' is used in the attributive position.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Kırmızı araba' ifadesinde 'kırmızı' niteleyici konumda kullanılır.

meanings.en: able to be known or predicted in advance
meanings.exampleEn: Prices are unlikely to fall in the foreseeable future.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatların öngörülebilir gelecekte düşmesi pek olası değil.

meanings.en: correctly predicting what will happen in the future
meanings.exampleEn: His warning about the crisis proved prophetic.
meanings.exampleTr: Kriz hakkındaki uyarısı kehanet gibi çıktı.
